resources.name: Plane-wave DFT code supporting PW91 functional

access.notes: Any plane-wave DFT code implementing PW91 GGA with ultrasoft pseudopotentials may be used. Quantum ESPRESSO is open-source and recommended.

resources.name: Ultrasoft pseudopotentials for Pt, O, H (PW91)

access.notes: Standard solid-state pseudopotentials (SSSP) library. Alternatively, the pseudopotentials can be generated with the atomic code included in Quantum ESPRESSO.
Use the DFT-calculated lattice constant of 3.9711 Å (experimental value 3.9239 Å). This value is widely known and used in the paper.
